implementation_summary: Added plan-aware assessment path extraction while preserving unified diff parsing.
Added risk assessment coverage metadata with per-path coverage, evidence counts, canonical experience IDs, and experience density.
Extended MCP coverage and assess responses to use the shared assessment engine and density semantics.
Added advisory forward-signal tracking tied to the saved ERR baseline, with missing baselines treated as non-blocking and malformed baselines failing closed.
Kept advisory restraint behavior deterministic: unchanged diff fingerprints skip before debounce, changed fingerprints debounce, and new covered_clean or below-min-confidence assessments stay silent.
